name: Code Block Leakage
description: Identifiers in code blocks should NOT be extracted as prose references
draftText:
UserService validates users. Example:
```typescript
const result = NonExistentService.process();
```
The validation ensures proper authentication.
notes: NonExistentService appears only in a code example block, not in prose. The validator should NOT extract identifiers from code blocks (fenced with backticks), so this should ACCEPT despite the non-existent entity in the code example.
